voice_install:
usage: herdr-theme voice_install [-h] [--home HOME] [--source SOURCE] [--enroll] [--check] [--no-start]

Install the voice plugin from this checkout and point every entry point at it.

  herdr-theme voice_install            install or update, then check
  herdr-theme voice_install --enroll   also enroll your voice (run in a shell pane)
  herdr-theme voice_install --check    only check that everything runs the installed copy

The plugin is copied to ~/.local/share/herdr-focus-queue/plugin, not run from
the checkout, so editing or switching a worktree never changes what is running.
The copy is swapped in as one directory: a herdr event that starts during the
update runs either the old copy or the new one, never a half-written mix.
`focusq install` from that copy then links it as the herdr plugin and points
the Claude Code submit hook, the Codex focus LaunchAgent and the Herdr app's
focus routing at it, replacing links to any earlier folder in the same step.

Your voice data stays where it was (~/.local/state/herdr/plugins/local.focus-
queue) and your own settings in voice.local.json (see the voice settings API).
Running voice connections are not stopped; listeners started before the
update finish on the code they started with.

Safe to run again. Exit 0 means installed and checked.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --home HOME  home folder to install into (another home implies --no-start)
  --source SOURCE
               voice source directory (required outside a source checkout)
  --enroll     also enroll your voice for the current microphone
  --check      only check the installed copy
  --no-start   write files only; start no LaunchAgent or download

native_ui_reload:
usage: herdr-theme native_ui_reload [-h] [--reloads RELOADS]
                           [--failed-reloads FAILED_RELOADS] [--install-smoke]

macOS native regression probe: real Sixfold renders in a disposable app/core.
Run manually: python3 tests/herdr-theme native_ui_reload [--reloads 80]. Saves four
synthetic theme shots, missing-export/restore results, reload stress receipts,
and a restart shot under /tmp. Never uses the user's app/core for commands.
Only the app/core launched with this probe's isolated env are stopped.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reloads RELOADS
  --failed-reloads FAILED_RELOADS
                        Repeat incomplete-import/restore cycles until OOM or
                        this limit
  --install-smoke       Exercise the guarded installer twice against the
                        disposable app
